resources.string: Closes and reopens this app. The car agents keep running.
The app closes and opens again in a couple of seconds. Your settings are kept. The car agents keep running and the boot activation does not change.
Restarts the factory media center and the music, radio and video players. Car services are not touched.

Playback stops. The factory media center and the music, radio and video players are closed; Android starts the media center again within a few seconds. Car services, the launcher, the cluster and warning sounds are not touched.
The media center is running again after %d s.
The media center has not started yet. If sound does not return within a minute, restart the system.
Reboots the whole head unit. Only in Park.
The head unit restarts completely: all screens go dark and music, navigation and calls stop for about a minute. The Open Voyah Controls car agents start again after the boot. Only available in Park.
The head unit is restarting. Open Voyah Controls and its car agents start again after the boot.
